facts.text: Fine, I'll pay for my own burger. But nobody's splitting the bill eight ways, I'm not doing the maths.
facts.why: Not Mr. Pink's words. The diner is a breakfast scene, there is no burger, and Pink's stand is that he doesn't tip. The real lines are 'I don't tip' and 'I don't tip because society says I have to'.
facts.fix: Order what you like, I'm on coffee. I don't tip because society says I have to, so don't look at me.

fix_note.text: Order what you like, I'm on coffee. I don't tip because society says I have to, so don't look at me.

facts.why: The note says Joe's big breakfast comes before he hands out the colour names. In the film Joe hands out the names before the heist, and the crew already use them at the diner (Mr. Pink, Mr. Orange).
facts.fix: Joe's big breakfast, the morning of the job
facts.full: Joe's big breakfast before he hands out the colour names

vibe.verdict: A police case file layout does not fit a heist film that is mostly about the crew, and the note falls flat next to the sharp tipping scene.
